special_message.title: A Little Reminder
special_message.text: Whatever this week brings, remember how proud I am of you. You are doing amazing!

quotes.quote: Good morning, my fiker. Walk into the studio today with your head held high. You have the brilliant mind of an architect and the gentlest heart, and I believe in you with everything I have.
quotes.author: Always Adonay

quotes.quote: Fiker, whenever studio feels overwhelming or the crits feel harsh, take a slow breath. Your worth and your talent are so much bigger than one review. I am standing right behind you, always.
quotes.author: Forever in Your Corner, Adonay

quotes.quote: Don't rush the process, fiker. Great architecture is built line by line, layer by layer, and cut by cut. You are growing into someone extraordinary, and I love you endlessly.
quotes.author: With All My Love, Adonay

quotes.quote: Remember to drink some water, unclench your jaw, and rest your hands, fiker. Seeing how passionately you pour yourself into your dreams inspires me every single day.
quotes.author: Thinking of You Always, Adonay

quotes.quote: To my dearest fiker: even when foam board, chipboard, and glue get messy and the hours stretch long into the night, your smile is still my whole universe. You've got this today!
quotes.author: Yours, Adonay

quotes.quote: Fiker, whenever self-doubt whispers in your ear, remember that I see your brilliance even when you temporarily lose sight of it. Keep designing, my love.
quotes.author: Believing in You Forever, Adonay

quotes.quote: Every master architect started exactly where you are sitting right now, fiker — with a blank sheet of trace paper and an idea. Trust your creative voice today.
quotes.author: Always Adonay

quotes.quote: Fiker, never forget why you fell in love with architecture. The world is waiting for the spaces, light, and beauty you are going to create. I am loving you every step of the way.
quotes.author: Always by Your Side, Adonay

quotes.quote: You have this quiet strength, fiker, that always finds a way forward no matter how complex the project gets. Go show them what you are made of!
quotes.author: Cheering for You Loudly, Adonay

quotes.quote: Fiker, you don't need to have every single floor plan and detail solved all at once. Just win this hour and this drawing. You are doing so much better than you realize.
quotes.author: Gentle Reminder from Adonay

quotes.quote: No matter how demanding this semester gets, fiker, my love for you is constant, steady, and unconditional. Come home proud of yourself today.
quotes.author: With All My Heart, Adonay

quotes.quote: My sweet fiker, take pride in how far you have come from your first line drawing. Every challenge you face in the studio is molding you into a visionary.
quotes.author: Endlessly Proud of You, Adonay

quotes.quote: Fiker, your sketches have soul and your models have care. Never lose that human touch that makes your work so special. I love you to the moon and back.
quotes.author: Your Adonay

quotes.quote: May your mind stay sharp, your hand stay steady, and your heart stay peaceful today, fiker. You are deeply loved every single second.
quotes.author: Forever Adonay

quotes.quote: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established; through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.
quotes.author: Proverbs 24:3–4

quotes.quote: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
quotes.author: Philippians 4:13

quotes.quote: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
quotes.author: Proverbs 3:5–6

quotes.quote: May the favor of the Lord our God rest on us; establish the work of our hands for us — yes, establish the work of our hands.
quotes.author: Psalm 90:17

quotes.quote: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
quotes.author: Jeremiah 29:11

quotes.quote: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.
quotes.author: Joshua 1:9

quotes.quote: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord and not for human masters.
quotes.author: Colossians 3:23

quotes.quote: He gives strength to the weary and increases the power of the weak... those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles.
quotes.author: Isaiah 40:29, 31

quotes.quote: According to the grace of God given to me, like a skilled master builder I laid a foundation, and someone else is building on it. But each one should build with care.
quotes.author: 1 Corinthians 3:10

quotes.quote: Therefore everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise builder who built their house on the rock.
quotes.author: Matthew 7:24

quotes.quote: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
quotes.author: Galatians 6:9

quotes.quote: For God gave us a spirit not of fear, but of power, love, and self-discipline.
quotes.author: 2 Timothy 1:7

quotes.quote: Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labor in vain. The Lord watches over your going out and your coming in from this time forth and forevermore.
quotes.author: Psalm 127:1 & 121:8

quotes.quote: Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established.
quotes.author: Proverbs 16:3

quotes.quote: There are 360 degrees, so why stick to one? Architecture is really about well-being. I think that people want to feel good in a space.
quotes.author: Zaha Hadid

quotes.quote: A great building must begin with the unmeasurable, must go through measurable means when it is being designed, and in the end must be unmeasurable.
quotes.author: Louis Kahn

quotes.quote: The mother art is architecture. Without an architecture of our own, we have no soul of our own civilization.
quotes.author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quotes.quote: Study nature, love nature, stay close to nature. It will never fail you.
quotes.author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quotes.quote: Architecture starts when you carefully put two bricks together. There it begins.
quotes.author: Ludwig Mies van der Rohe

quotes.quote: God is in the details.
quotes.author: Ludwig Mies van der Rohe

quotes.quote: Architecture is art, but art very much contaminated by many other things: by society, by science, by physics, by the poetry of light.
quotes.author: Renzo Piano

quotes.quote: I believe that architecture should be about creating places where people feel alive and connected to nature.
quotes.author: Tadao Ando

quotes.quote: You cannot simply put something new into a place; you have to absorb what exists around you, on the land, and then use that knowledge with contemporary thinking.
quotes.author: Tadao Ando

quotes.quote: Architecture is the learned game, correct and magnificent, of forms assembled in the light.
quotes.author: Le Corbusier

quotes.quote: To fly, you have to be willing to give up the ground. Architecture is about that leap of imagination into a new way of seeing.
quotes.author: Maya Lin

quotes.quote: Those who look for the laws of Nature as a support for their new works collaborate with the Creator.
quotes.author: Antoni Gaudí

quotes.quote: Limitation makes the creative mind inventive.
quotes.author: Walter Gropius (Bauhaus)

quotes.quote: Design is nothing but a humble understanding of materials, light, and the human spirit.
quotes.author: Balkrishna Doshi (Pritzker Laureate)

quotes.quote: As an architect you design for the present, with an awareness of the past, for a future which is essentially unknown.
quotes.author: Norman Foster

quotes.quote: Architecture is about trying to make the world a little more like our dreams.
quotes.author: Bjarke Ingels (BIG)

quotes.quote: Linear time is a Western invention; time is not linear, it is a marvelous entanglement where at any moment points can be chosen and invented without beginning or end.
quotes.author: Lina Bo Bardi

cheer_messages.title: Mid-Week Recharge, Fiker
cheer_messages.text: Today is completely free from classes. Put down the cutter and the scale ruler, fiker. Make a warm cup of coffee, relax your hands, and breathe. You worked so hard this week, and you truly deserve this rest.

cheer_messages.title: Time Just for My Architect
cheer_messages.text: No studio reviews, no rushing across campus today. Just quiet time for my favorite person in the world. I am thinking of you all day, fiker, and sending you the warmest hugs.

cheer_messages.title: Rest Is Part of the Design
cheer_messages.text: Even the greatest buildings need spaces between them to breathe, fiker. Rest is not wasted time — it's where your creativity recharges. I love you and I am endlessly proud of you.

cheer_messages.title: A Gentle Whisper for Fiker
cheer_messages.text: You are doing so wonderfully, my fiker. Don't worry about next week's juries or deadlines today. Let your mind wander freely and remember how deeply and fiercely you are loved.

cheer_messages.title: Peace in the Midst of the Semester
cheer_messages.text: Take today slow, fiker. The semester moves fast, but today belongs to you. May your heart feel peaceful knowing that you always have a home in my love.
